data.hypothesis: Increasing source-loop unrolling from four to eight may further reduce loop-control overhead while preserving the validated force arithmetic and accumulation order. The unroll-4 candidate was correct and slightly faster than baseline; this variant still requires measurement.
data.notes: Only src/nbody_kernel.cu changes; launch.json is unchanged. The controller must freshly verify correctness and measure this unroll-8 variant before drawing conclusions.
transformations: Increase source-loop unrolling from four to eight.
Preserve baseline float32 force arithmetic, per-source accumulation order, interface, and launch configuration.
